1_sight_line.cause: the Sight socket sat on the notch BOTTOM (45.5) with the post tip at 45.0: an eye on that line sees the tip exactly on the notch floor (post hidden behind the leaf); the slider roof (traced 48.5) stood 0.5 above the notch top right in front of it and formed a false higher notch (measured 0.58 mm)
1_sight_line.fix: Sight socket at the notch TOP centre (449.9, 0, 48.0), pitch -0.4579 to the post tip (spec R48); slider roof 47.6

2_dust_cover.construction: pressed sheet 0.98: outer loft (skirts to Z 22.26, R 8 shoulders, gentle R 48 crown, rise 2.9) minus the cavity loft; formed rear hood (section scaled by the traced rear profile), lip end over the receiver top; 0.3 breaks on cut edges only; smooth lofted faces (no seam)

3_buttstock.section: swelling oval: butt plate lozenge at the butt, superellipse 3.3 -> 2.9 -> 2.45 to the wrist; no uniform round-over; conformal inletted wrist plate

4_selector.construction: one flat 2.0 stamped blade, top edge raised to Z 8.0 (closes the slot band to 1.6 under the skirt edge), crease a 0.35 pressed step, tab bent 12 deg, low washer 0.5 + head 0.9, 0.3 edge breaks

5_trigger_guard.section: stamped channel: flat web 10 wide outside, R 1.0 bends, flat 1.0 flanges (side band 3.25-4.4 as traced), web 1.6, crisp 0.25 breaks

6_ribs_checkering.mag_ribs: half widths 2.0-2.15, pressed out 0.95, rounded swell profile
6_ribs_checkering.checker: pitch 1.8 diamonds, V cut 0.70 into a 0.75 recess, crisp 0.25 cut border
